_comment: Cross-language contract for warning categorization and deploy status.
The same rules are implemented twice — src/a2d/observability/ in Python and
frontend/src/lib/ in TypeScript — so the CLI and the web UI agree on what a
conversion means. Nothing structural stops those two from drifting, and a
drift is user-visible: the UI would show a different deploy verdict than the
Both sides assert against THIS file:
Add a case here when you change either implementation; a one-sided change
then fails the other language's suite.
